[1/1] Rebuild logo/social text lockups and review every asset individually

impact_assessment.why: The user judged the text lockups weak and required each logo to be analyzed one by one for project fit, aesthetics and theme.
impact_assessment.benefits: Per-project title-case lockups, category eyebrows, unique monograms, curated taglines, and individual vision verdicts for all 39 logos and 39 social cards.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: logos and social cards are re-rendered with new lockups; dependency: Playwright/Chromium and a vision model; concurrency: sequential asset application and pushes; state: assets return to pending_review until re-approved.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Every logo/social opened individually by a vision subagent; rejects fixed and re-reviewed; media audits report pending=0; all gates pass.
